label: scam
text: Dear Customer, your SBI YONO account will be blocked today due to pending KYC. Update PAN immediately: http://sbi-kyc-update.top/login
tip: Banks never send KYC links by SMS. The domain is not sbi.co.in, and 'blocked today' is pressure to stop you thinking.

label: genuine
text: Rs 2,450.00 debited from A/c XX4821 on 04-10-26 by UPI ref 428193007211. Not you? Call 1800-1234 (toll free) or SMS BLOCK to 9223008333. -Bank
tip: A plain debit alert with a reference number and a toll-free number to call if it wasn't you. It asks you for nothing.

label: scam
text: Join our VIP Telegram group! SEBI registered expert gives 100% accurate calls. Earn 3% daily guaranteed profit. Only 20 seats left, pay Rs 2999 now.
tip: 3% a day is over 4,80,000% a year: impossible. 'Guaranteed', 'only 20 seats' and a fee for tips are classic signs. No SEBI number is shown.

label: genuine
text: 482913 is your OTP for login to your net banking. Valid for 5 minutes. Do not share this OTP with anyone, including bank staff.
tip: A real OTP message warns you NOT to share it. It is only a problem if someone calls asking you to read it out.

label: scam
text: This is Inspector Sharma, CBI Cyber Cell. A parcel with drugs in your name was seized at Mumbai airport. You are under digital arrest. Stay on video call and transfer your savings for verification.
tip: There is no such thing as 'digital arrest'. Police and CBI never arrest anyone on a video call or ask you to move money for 'verification'.

label: scam
text: Part-time job! Like YouTube videos and earn Rs 150 per like. Daily income 5000-8000. Contact HR on WhatsApp wa.me/919812345678
tip: Paid 'like' tasks are a known trap: you get small payouts first, then are asked to 'invest' to unlock bigger tasks and lose it all.

label: genuine
text: SEBI cautions investors: do not deal with unregistered entities offering assured returns on social media. Verify intermediaries at sebi.gov.in before investing.
tip: This is an awareness message. It points you to the official sebi.gov.in website and promises nothing.

label: scam
text: Congratulations! Your mobile number won Rs 25,00,000 in KBC Lucky Draw. To claim, pay processing fee Rs 12,500 to the RBI approved agent.
tip: You cannot win a lottery you never entered. Any 'prize' that needs a fee first is a scam, and RBI does not appoint prize agents.

label: scam
text: Sorry bhai, I sent Rs 5000 to your UPI by mistake. Please return it, I have sent you a request, just enter your PIN to approve.
tip: You never need your UPI PIN to RECEIVE money. Entering the PIN on a 'request' sends money out of your account.

label: genuine
text: Your credit card statement for Sep-26 is ready. Total due Rs 8,210, minimum due Rs 410, due date 22-10-26. Pay via your bank app or net banking.
tip: A normal statement reminder: no link to click, no urgency, and it tells you to pay through your own bank app.

label: scam
text: Dear consumer your electricity power will be disconnected tonight at 9.30 pm because your previous month bill was not updated. Please immediately contact our electricity officer 9876501234.
tip: Power companies don't threaten same-night cut-offs by SMS from a mobile number. The goal is to get you on a call and install a screen-sharing app.

label: scam
text: Bhai ek scheme hai, 50 hazaar lagao aur 3 mahine me 1 lakh pakka. Bas 2 log aur jodne hain, commission alag milega.
tip: Doubling money in 3 months and earning by recruiting people is how Ponzi schemes work: early members are paid with new members' money.

label: genuine
text: Your order #402-7781 has been shipped and will arrive by Thursday. Track it in the app under My Orders.
tip: A shipping update that sends you to the app you already use, with no payment request or link from an unknown site.

label: scam
text: Download our trading app and get Rs 1000 bonus. My students made 300% returns in one week, see screenshots! Withdraw anytime. Link: tradepro-india.apk
tip: APK downloads, 'students' profit screenshots and 300% a week are signs of fake trading apps that show fake profits and block withdrawals.

label: scam
text: Hello dear, I am sending you an iPhone and $50,000 as a gift from London. Customs officer will call, please pay the clearance charge of Rs 35,000.
tip: Gift and 'customs clearance' messages, often after an online friendship, are a romance-scam pattern. Real customs duty is never paid to a person's account.

label: genuine
text: You have received Rs 1,200.00 from RAHUL K via UPI. UPI Ref: 627119045532. Balance updated in your account.
tip: A credit message. Receiving money never needs your PIN, OTP or any action from you.

label: scam
text: Your PAN card will be deactivated today. Link Aadhaar now at http://incometax-pan-update.in or pay penalty Rs 10,000.
tip: The real income-tax website ends in .gov.in. Penalty threats with a link are designed to steal your Aadhaar, PAN and bank details.

label: scam
text: URGENT: this small-cap stock will go 10x by Friday. Big operators are buying. Buy before 10 AM tomorrow, don't tell anyone!
tip: 'Secret tips', '10x by Friday' and 'buy before 10 AM' are pump-and-dump signs: promoters sell to you after pushing the price up.

label: genuine
text: RBI Kehta Hai: Never share your card details, PIN or OTP with anyone. Banks never ask for them. Report fraud at 1930.
tip: RBI's public awareness campaign. It asks you to share nothing and points to the official 1930 helpline.

label: scam
text: Hi Mummy, this is my new number, my phone broke. I urgently need Rs 18,000 for college fees, please send to this UPI today, I'll explain later.
tip: A 'new number' plus an urgent money request is a common impersonation trick. Always call the old number or meet first.

label: scam
text: Instant personal loan of Rs 2 lakh approved without documents! Pay Rs 1,999 file charge to activate. Offer valid for 2 hours.
tip: Genuine lenders deduct fees from the loan, never ask for advance 'file charges', and never give a 2-hour deadline.

label: genuine
text: Dear customer, your fixed deposit no. XX9012 of Rs 50,000 matures on 15-11-26. Visit your branch or bank app to renew.
tip: A maturity reminder from your own bank, sending you to the branch or app. No link, no urgency, no request for details.

label: scam
text: Invest in our AI crypto bot. Fixed 15% monthly ROI assured, capital 100% safe. Refer friends and earn team bonus up to 10 levels.
tip: 'Assured monthly ROI', 'capital safe' and multi-level referral bonuses are signs of a Ponzi scheme wearing a crypto label.

label: scam
text: आपका बैंक खाता आज बंद हो जाएगा। तुरंत KYC अपडेट करें और OTP बताएं: 9123456780 पर कॉल करें।
tip: No bank asks you to call a mobile number and read out your OTP. Account-closing threats in Hindi or English are the same trick.

label: genuine
text: Your mobile number is registered with DigiLocker. To view documents, open the official DigiLocker app or visit digilocker.gov.in.
tip: It points to the official app and a .gov.in website, and asks for nothing.

label: scam
text: Guaranteed IPO allotment through our special quota! Pay Rs 25,000 to our account and get listing-day profit of 80%. Limited quota.
tip: There is no 'special quota' for guaranteed IPO allotment. IPO applications go only through your own bank (ASBA) or broker app.

label: scam
text: Your credit card reward points worth Rs 7,850 expire today! Redeem now: http://rewards-hdfc-redeem.co/claim
tip: Reward-point expiry links are used to steal card numbers and OTPs. Check points only in your bank's own app.

label: genuine
text: Your SIP of Rs 1,000 in your mutual fund folio was processed on 05-10-26. Units will be allotted at the applicable NAV.
tip: A routine confirmation of a payment you set up yourself. It promises no returns and asks for nothing.

label: scam
text: Your SIM card will be blocked in 24 hours as per TRAI rules. Press 9 to speak to our customer care executive.
tip: TRAI does not call to block SIMs. These calls try to get your Aadhaar or OTP, or to swap your SIM. Report them on Sanchar Saathi (Chakshu).

label: scam
text: Your LIC policy bonus of Rs 1,45,000 is pending. To release it, pay GST of Rs 4,800 to the officer's account today.
tip: Insurers never collect 'GST' or charges into a person's account to release a bonus. Check only with LIC's official app or branch.

label: genuine
text: Cyber Dost: Beware of fake customer care numbers on search engines. Always take helpline numbers from the official website or app.
tip: A government cyber-safety tip. It warns you and asks for nothing.

label: scam
text: Congratulations! You are selected for work-from-home data entry job, salary Rs 35,000/month. Pay Rs 2,500 registration fee to confirm your seat.
tip: Real employers never charge a fee to hire you. 'Selected' without an interview, plus a fee, is a job scam.

label: scam
text: Mukesh Ambani's new government-backed platform: invest Rs 21,000 and earn Rs 5 lakh per month. Watch his video and register now!
tip: Deepfake videos of famous people are used to sell fake platforms. No real public figure promotes 'invest 21,000, earn 5 lakh a month'.

label: genuine
text: Login to net banking from a new device on 06-10-26 at 21:14. If this wasn't you, call our 24x7 helpline on the back of your card.
tip: A security alert telling you to use the number on the back of your own card. It doesn't give you a number or link to use.

label: scam
text: Refund of Rs 2,300 is pending for your cancelled order. Install AnyDesk and share the 9-digit code so our executive can process the refund.
tip: Screen-sharing apps like AnyDesk let the caller see and control your phone, including OTPs and banking apps. Refunds never need them.

label: scam
text: I am a certified wealth manager. Give me access to your demat account and I will trade for you. 50-50 profit sharing, no loss guaranteed.
tip: Never share demat login or PINs. 'No loss guaranteed' and profit-sharing on your account are illegal and a common fraud.
